versions.changelog:
probe_first_research v1.0.0 — Initial release

- Introduces a "probe-first" deep research workflow that maps the information landscape using search snippets before deeper research.
- Automatically generates 2–3 reconnaissance queries and synthesizes a Probe Report summarizing information density, terminology, source types, entities, controversy, and other dimensions.
- Presents structured research planning (framework selection, sub-question decomposition) based on real search signals, not assumptions.
- Includes user-invocable stop point for plan confirmation and supports dynamic adjustment (depth, multi-agent execution, freshness constraints).
- Deep search phase strategically fetches and analyzes high-value sources, guided by initial probe findings.
